title: Microsoft 365 Backup: Teams channel backup and recovery
summary: Hold until the existing-workload price is qualified: Microsoft now documents Entra Premium backup at a per-object rate, so $0.15 per GiB per month is not the price of every existing workload. The Teams roadmap facts remain supported, and searches found no Teams-specific pricing or configuration documentation. Several otherwise correct control paths and the Graph note need small clarifications.

Extend the UI path to 'Settings > Microsoft 365 Backup > SharePoint > Set up policy > Choose selection method > Backup Settings' and add to the note: 'This UI route creates a SharePoint policy; Backup Settings sets its Recovery window.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/backup/backup-view-edit-policies#create-backup-policies.
